nodes.name: Checkout GraphQL schema
nodes.summary: The GraphQL queries, types, dataloaders and mutations a storefront uses to build a cart, pick delivery and complete the checkout.
nodes.detail: graphql/checkout holds the public surface of checkout. schema.py registers the checkout, checkouts and checkoutLines queries and every checkout mutation; graphql/api.py (owned by the platform area) mounts them into the one schema served at POST /graphql/. types.py resolves prices lazily: totalPrice, subtotalPrice and the line prices go through a price-calculation dataloader that calls fetch_checkout_data, so reading a price is what triggers a recalculation once the stored prices have expired. Mutations edit the checkout row, mark prices as expired and send asynchronous CHECKOUT_UPDATED webhooks; only checkoutComplete turns the cart into an order.

nodes.name: Checkout mutations
nodes.summary: One class per checkout mutation: create, edit lines, addresses, customer, delivery method, promo codes, and complete.
nodes.detail: Every mutation resolves the checkout by id (or the deprecated token or checkoutId), loads lines and a CheckoutInfo, applies its change inside a database transaction and then calls invalidate_checkout, which recalculates discounts and sets price_expiration to now so the next price read recalculates taxes. Address and line changes also set delivery_methods_stale_at to now so shipping options are fetched again. Each ends by sending an asynchronous CHECKOUT_CREATED or CHECKOUT_UPDATED webhook through the plugin manager. Smaller mutations not drawn as boxes (checkoutCustomerDetach, checkoutCustomerNoteUpdate, checkoutLanguageCodeUpdate, checkoutDelete and the deprecated checkoutShippingMethodUpdate) follow the same pattern.

nodes.name: Cart state and lines
nodes.summary: The Checkout, CheckoutLine and CheckoutDelivery models, the CheckoutInfo snapshot every function works on, line edits, events and clean-up jobs.
nodes.detail: A checkout is a row keyed by a token UUID (universally unique identifier) with lines, addresses, an assigned delivery, vouchers, gift cards and cached prices with an expiry. fetch.py builds CheckoutInfo and CheckoutLineInfo objects (lines with variant, product, channel listing and tax class) that the price, delivery and completion code share. utils.py adds variants under row locks and reserves stock, actions.py maps checkout events to plugin manager hooks, and tasks.py deletes abandoned checkouts, re-indexes search and completes fully authorized checkouts automatically.

nodes.name: Delivery options
nodes.summary: Shipping methods and click-and-collect points for a checkout, cached as CheckoutDelivery rows and refreshed from shipping apps.
nodes.detail: delivery_context.py collects built-in shipping methods for the checkout's address and weight, asks shipping apps for more with the SHIPPING_LIST_METHODS_FOR_CHECKOUT synchronous webhook, lets apps hide some with CHECKOUT_FILTER_SHIPPING_METHODS, and stores the result as CheckoutDelivery rows. delivery_methods_stale_at controls the cache: it is set to now plus CHECKOUT_DELIVERY_OPTIONS_TTL (default 24 hours) after a refresh and back to now when lines or the address change. The assigned delivery is kept even when it disappears from the list, and is marked invalid instead.

nodes.name: Price and tax recalculation
nodes.summary: Recalculates checkout prices, discounts and taxes when the cached prices expire, using flat rates, a tax app, or a tax plugin.
nodes.detail: Prices are stored on the checkout and its lines together with price_expiration. fetch_checkout_data returns them untouched until that time passes (CHECKOUT_PRICES_TTL, default 1 hour) or a caller forces an update; then it recalculates discounts, computes base prices, and applies taxes from the channel's strategy: flat rates from tax classes, the CHECKOUT_CALCULATE_TAXES synchronous webhook to a tax app, or the legacy plugin hooks. The result is saved only if the checkout's last_change did not move during the calculation, then payment statuses are refreshed. A tax app failure leaves untaxed base prices and records tax_error, which blocks completion.

nodes.name: Checkout completion
nodes.summary: Validates a checkout, locks it, reserves stock, takes payment where needed and creates the order, then deletes the checkout.
nodes.detail: complete_checkout first forces fresh prices, then chooses a path. When the checkout is fully authorized by transactions, has transactions but no active legacy payment, belongs to a channel that allows unpaid orders, or totals zero under the transaction flow, it runs complete_checkout_with_transaction: validate, increase voucher usage, lock the row, create the order and its lines, allocate stock and move payments over. Otherwise the legacy path locks the checkout, sets completing_started_at, adds short stock reservations, calls the payment gateway outside the lock, and creates the order afterwards. Orders are created by the orders area's models; this code only fills them.

nodes.name: Transaction payments
nodes.summary: The transaction model of payments: TransactionItem and TransactionEvent rows, session webhooks to payment apps, and amount recalculation.
nodes.detail: A payment app owns the money movement; Saleor keeps a ledger. Each TransactionItem belongs to a checkout or an order and holds authorized, charged, refunded and canceled amounts plus their pending counterparts. Every change is a TransactionEvent, and recalculate_transaction_amounts rebuilds the amounts from the events grouped by payment service provider (PSP) reference. Sessions start with the TRANSACTION_INITIALIZE_SESSION and TRANSACTION_PROCESS_SESSION synchronous webhooks; later the app reports changes with transactionEventReport. After any change the checkout's authorize and charge statuses are recomputed, which can fire CHECKOUT_FULLY_PAID and enable automatic completion.

nodes.name: Payment GraphQL schema
nodes.summary: GraphQL mutations and types for transactions, payment gateways and stored payment methods, plus the deprecated payment mutations.
nodes.detail: graphql/payment registers payment, payments, transaction and transactions queries and the transaction mutations: paymentGatewayInitialize, transactionInitialize, transactionProcess (storefront), transactionCreate, transactionUpdate, transactionEventReport (payment apps), and transactionRequestAction and transactionRequestRefundForGrantedRefund (staff). Session mutations share TransactionSessionBase, which resolves the checkout or order and the amount to pay. Legacy paymentCapture, paymentRefund, paymentVoid, paymentInitialize and paymentCheckBalance stay registered with a deprecation reason.

nodes.name: Legacy payments and gateway plugins
nodes.summary: The older Payment and Transaction models driven through plugin gateways, kept for checkoutPaymentCreate and the deprecated Stripe plugin.
nodes.detail: Before the transaction model, a storefront created a Payment on the checkout and checkoutComplete called the gateway plugin to process it. payment/gateway.py wraps every plugin call with locking and error handling and records a Transaction row per attempt; it also routes the newer transaction action requests (charge, refund, cancel) to apps or plugins. The bundled Stripe plugin is marked deprecated in its name; it creates payment intents and receives Stripe events through the plugin webhook route.

nodes.name: Tax configuration and calculation
nodes.summary: Per-channel tax configuration with country exceptions, tax classes and flat rates, and the synchronous tax webhooks to tax apps.
nodes.detail: Each channel has one TaxConfiguration: whether to charge taxes, whether prices are entered gross, whether to display gross prices, and a strategy of FLAT_RATES or TAX_APP with an optional tax_app_id. TaxConfigurationPerCountry rows override those values for one country. Flat rates come from TaxClassCountryRate rows per tax class and country, with a class-less row as the country default. The TAX_APP strategy sends CHECKOUT_CALCULATE_TAXES or ORDER_CALCULATE_TAXES to the configured app, or to every subscribed app when no identifier is set, and validates the reply line by line.

nodes.name: Tax GraphQL schema
nodes.summary: Staff queries and mutations for tax configurations, country exceptions, tax classes and per-checkout or per-order exemptions.
nodes.detail: graphql/tax exposes taxConfiguration(s), taxClass(es) and taxCountryConfiguration(s) queries and the mutations taxConfigurationUpdate, taxCountryConfigurationUpdate and Delete, taxClassCreate, Update and Delete, and taxExemptionManage, all behind the MANAGE_TAXES permission. Exemptions apply to a checkout or to a draft or unconfirmed order.

nodes.name: Built-in AvaTax plugin
nodes.summary: The deprecated in-process Avalara AvaTax plugin: calculates checkout and order taxes over the AvaTax REST interface and commits confirmed orders.
nodes.detail: DeprecatedAvataxPlugin implements the plugin manager's tax hooks. It builds a createTransactionModel request from checkout or order lines with tax codes taken from product metadata, posts it to the sandbox or production AvaTax address with basic authentication, and caches the reply in the Django cache for 1 hour keyed by checkout token (10 seconds for failures). preprocess_order_creation raises a tax error to stop completion when AvaTax rejects the checkout, and order_confirmed queues a Celery task that commits the transaction. It runs only when the channel uses TAX_APP and its tax_app_id is empty or names this plugin.

nodes.name: Gift cards
nodes.summary: Gift cards as bearer codes with balances: issued by staff or bought in orders, applied to checkouts, charged as transactions, with an event log.
nodes.detail: A GiftCard has a code, currency, initial and current balance, optional expiry date and an optional customer assignment that restricts who may spend it. Two ways to pay exist: the legacy path attaches cards to the checkout (checkoutAddPromoCode) and deducts balances when the order is created; the newer path is a built-in payment gateway, saleor.io.gift-card-payment-gateway, used through transactionInitialize, which authorizes the amount on a TransactionItem and charges the card when the order is created. Every change writes a GiftCardEvent.

nodes.name: Gift card GraphQL schema
nodes.summary: Staff queries and mutations to create, update, activate, assign, adjust, resend and bulk-manage gift cards.
nodes.detail: graphql/giftcard registers giftCard, giftCards, giftCardCurrencies and giftCardTags queries and fourteen mutations, including bulk create, delete, activate and deactivate. All need the MANAGE_GIFT_CARD permission. Creating a card can email it to a customer through the notify hook; balance changes go through giftCardBalanceAdjust, which locks the card row.

nodes.name: Checkout schema registration
nodes.summary: Registers the checkout, checkouts and checkoutLines queries and maps every checkout mutation field to its class.
nodes.detail: CheckoutQueries resolves a single checkout by id or token (anyone but the owner needs MANAGE_CHECKOUTS, IMPERSONATE_USER or HANDLE_PAYMENTS), paginated checkouts for MANAGE_CHECKOUTS or HANDLE_PAYMENTS, and checkoutLines for MANAGE_CHECKOUTS. CheckoutMutations lists twenty fields; checkoutPaymentCreate and checkoutShippingMethodUpdate stay with a deprecation reason pointing at the transaction flow and checkoutDeliveryMethodUpdate.

nodes.name: Checkout GraphQL types
nodes.summary: The Checkout, CheckoutLine, Delivery and problem types, whose price fields trigger recalculation through dataloaders.
nodes.detail: Prices, shipping methods, available payment gateways and problems are all resolved through dataloaders keyed by checkout token, so one request batches lookups. Fields wrapped with prevent_sync_event_circular_query (graphql/checkout/utils.py) raise CircularSubscriptionSyncEvent when resolved for a synchronous webhook payload whose event type is not allowed, which stops a tax app's subscription from recursively asking for taxed prices.

nodes.name: Checkout type
nodes.summary: The GraphQL Checkout object: lines, addresses, delivery, prices, payment statuses, transactions, problems and available gateways.

nodes.name: Checkout.resolve_total_price()
nodes.summary: Loads recalculated prices through the price dataloader and subtracts the attached gift card balances from the gross total.
nodes.detail: The loader calls fetch_checkout_data for the checkout, which recalculates prices if they expired. The resolver then deducts the legacy gift card balance from the gross amount, never below zero, and scales the net amount by the original gross-to-net ratio.
nodes.signature: def resolve_total_price(root: SyncWebhookControlContext[models.Checkout], info: ResolveInfo )

nodes.name: Checkout dataloaders
nodes.summary: Batch loaders for checkouts, lines, CheckoutInfo objects, recalculated prices, deliveries, promotion rules and problems.
nodes.detail: Seven files of DataLoader classes keyed by checkout token. checkout_infos.py assembles CheckoutInfo and line infos from many smaller loaders (channel, addresses, tax configuration, vouchers, variants, listings). calculations.py runs fetch_checkout_data for each requested checkout, keyed also by whether synchronous webhooks are allowed. problems.py computes stock and availability problems for lines and the checkout.

nodes.name: Price calculation loader
nodes.summary: Batch loader that runs fetch_checkout_data per checkout so price fields return fresh, taxed amounts.

nodes.name: Shared mutation helpers
nodes.summary: Shared checks for checkout mutations: resolve the checkout, group line input, validate quantities, availability and price overrides.
nodes.detail: get_checkout picks the checkout by id or the deprecated token and checkoutId arguments. check_lines_quantity enforces the per-checkout quantity limit from site settings and stock availability. mark_checkout_deliveries_as_stale_if_needed sets delivery_methods_stale_at to now when lines need shipping, so delivery options are fetched again. check_permissions_for_custom_prices allows price overrides only for apps with HANDLE_CHECKOUTS.

nodes.name: CheckoutCreate
nodes.summary: checkoutCreate: creates a checkout in a channel with optional lines, email and addresses, reserving stock for the lines.
nodes.detail: Cleans the channel, lines and addresses (address validation can be skipped only by apps with HANDLE_CHECKOUTS), then in one database transaction saves the checkout, sets its country, adds variants through add_variants_to_checkout with the site's reservation length, and copies addresses. A gift reward from an order promotion may be added, and the CHECKOUT_CREATED asynchronous webhook is sent. Prices start expired, so the first price read computes them.

nodes.name: CheckoutLinesAdd
nodes.summary: checkoutLinesAdd: adds variants or increases quantities, then marks deliveries stale and prices expired.
nodes.detail: Validates line metadata and custom price permissions, groups input with existing lines, checks quantity limits, stock and channel availability, and writes the lines with add_variants_to_checkout. It then calls mark_checkout_deliveries_as_stale_if_needed and invalidate_checkout, saves the affected fields, flags the search index as dirty and sends CHECKOUT_UPDATED.

nodes.name: CheckoutLinesUpdate
nodes.summary: checkoutLinesUpdate: replaces quantities of existing lines; a quantity of zero removes the line. Reuses the add flow.

nodes.name: CheckoutLinesDelete
nodes.summary: checkoutLinesDelete: removes lines by id, marks deliveries stale, expires prices and sends CHECKOUT_UPDATED.

nodes.name: CheckoutShippingAddressUpdate
nodes.summary: checkoutShippingAddressUpdate: validates and stores the shipping address, then refreshes delivery options and expires prices.
nodes.detail: Validates the address format for the destination country unless validation is skipped by an app with HANDLE_CHECKOUTS, sets the checkout country, re-checks line stock for it when the channel uses the legacy error flow, and stores a copy through change_shipping_address_in_checkout. Because tax and shipping depend on the address, it marks deliveries stale, calls invalidate_checkout and sends CHECKOUT_UPDATED.

nodes.name: CheckoutBillingAddressUpdate
nodes.summary: checkoutBillingAddressUpdate: stores the billing address and expires prices, since taxes may depend on it.

nodes.name: CheckoutDeliveryMethodUpdate
nodes.summary: checkoutDeliveryMethodUpdate: assigns a shipping method or a click-and-collect warehouse, or clears the delivery.
nodes.detail: Decodes the delivery method id as a shipping method or a warehouse. A shipping method must match a valid CheckoutDelivery row (fetched again if stale); a warehouse must be a valid collection point for the lines. assign_delivery_method_to_checkout then saves the choice, expires prices and sends CHECKOUT_UPDATED. Channels with use_legacy_error_flow_for_checkout reject unavailable lines and checkouts that need no shipping.

nodes.name: CheckoutEmailUpdate
nodes.summary: checkoutEmailUpdate: validates and sets the customer email, needed before completion, and sends CHECKOUT_UPDATED.

nodes.name: CheckoutCustomerAttach
nodes.summary: checkoutCustomerAttach: links the checkout to the signed-in customer, or to any customer for apps that can impersonate users.

nodes.name: CheckoutAddPromoCode
nodes.summary: checkoutAddPromoCode: applies a voucher code or attaches a gift card code, then expires prices.
nodes.detail: Calls add_promo_code_to_checkout, which tries the code as a voucher first and as a gift card second; gift cards are refused when the channel disallows legacy gift card use. Unknown or restricted codes fail with a generic rejection that does not reveal who a card is assigned to.

nodes.name: CheckoutRemovePromoCode
nodes.summary: checkoutRemovePromoCode: removes a voucher or gift card by code or id and expires prices.

nodes.name: CheckoutComplete
nodes.summary: checkoutComplete: validates addresses and lines and turns the checkout into an order, returning the order or confirmation data.
nodes.detail: If the checkout is gone but an order with its token exists, the mutation returns that order as a success, which makes retries safe. Otherwise it rejects unavailable variants and empty carts, refreshes stale delivery options, re-validates both addresses with normalization (unless validation was skipped), and calls complete_checkout with the requesting user, or the checkout's own user when the requestor may impersonate users. The legacy payment path can return confirmationNeeded with gateway data instead of an order.

nodes.name: OrderCreateFromCheckout
nodes.summary: orderCreateFromCheckout: lets an app with HANDLE_CHECKOUTS create an order from a checkout without the payment checks, optionally keeping the checkout.
nodes.detail: Validates the checkout, then calls create_order_from_checkout with delete_checkout taken from the removeCheckout argument (default true). It does not require the checkout to be paid; the app takes responsibility for collecting payment.

nodes.name: CheckoutCreateFromOrder
nodes.summary: checkoutCreateFromOrder: builds a new checkout from a past order's lines, reporting lines whose variants are no longer available.

nodes.name: Checkout models
nodes.summary: Database models for Checkout, CheckoutLine, CheckoutDelivery and CheckoutMetadata, stored in PostgreSQL.
nodes.detail: Checkout carries cached money fields (total, subtotal, shipping price and their base, undiscounted versions), price_expiration and discount_expiration, authorize_status and charge_status, completing_started_at as a soft lock, tax_error, a search vector and indexes for automatic completion. CheckoutLine stores quantity, optional price override and denormalized prices and tax rate. CheckoutDelivery caches each offered shipping method with a unique constraint per checkout, method id and validity. Metadata lives in a separate CheckoutMetadata row.

nodes.name: Checkout model
nodes.summary: The checkout row, keyed by a token, with cached prices, payment statuses, delivery choice and completion lock.
facts: Primary key is a token UUID (universally unique identifier)
price_expiration and discount_expiration default to now

nodes.name: Checkout.is_checkout_locked()
nodes.summary: True while a completion started less than CHECKOUT_COMPLETION_LOCK_TIME seconds ago; transaction mutations refuse to run then.
nodes.detail: Compares completing_started_at with now. It uses timedelta.seconds, which ignores whole days, so a completion that started more than a day ago and never cleared can look locked again for a few minutes each day.
nodes.signature: def is_checkout_locked(self) -> bool

nodes.name: CheckoutLine model
nodes.summary: One cart line: variant, quantity, optional price override with reason, metadata and cached prices with tax rate.

nodes.name: CheckoutDelivery model
nodes.summary: A cached delivery option for a checkout: built-in or external method id, name, price, delivery days, tax class copy and validity.

nodes.name: Checkout status constants
nodes.summary: AddressType, CheckoutChargeStatus (none, partial, full, overcharged) and CheckoutAuthorizeStatus (none, partial, full).

nodes.name: Checkout info assembly
nodes.summary: Builds the CheckoutInfo and CheckoutLineInfo snapshots that price, delivery and completion code all share.
nodes.detail: fetch_checkout_lines loads lines with variants, products, product types, collections, channel listings, tax classes and discounts in a few queries, and drops lines whose variant is no longer sold in the channel (returning their ids). fetch_checkout_info gathers channel, addresses, tax configuration, voucher and code, discounts and the user into a CheckoutInfo dataclass. CheckoutInfo answers the delivery method and active country for the rest of the code.

nodes.name: CheckoutInfo
nodes.summary: Dataclass snapshot of a checkout with channel, addresses, tax configuration, vouchers, discounts, lines and delivery method helpers.

nodes.name: fetch_checkout_lines()
nodes.summary: Loads checkout lines with everything pricing needs and returns them with the ids of variants no longer available.
nodes.signature: def fetch_checkout_lines(checkout: "Checkout", prefetch_variant_attributes: bool = False, skip_lines_with_unavailable_variants: bool = True, skip_recalculation: bool = False, voucher: Optional["Voucher"] = None, database_connection_name: str = settings.DATABASE_CONNECTION_DEFAULT_NAME) -> tuple[list

nodes.name: fetch_checkout_info()
nodes.summary: Assembles a CheckoutInfo from the checkout, its lines and the plugin manager, optionally with a given voucher and code.
nodes.signature: def fetch_checkout_info(checkout: "Checkout", lines: list[CheckoutLineInfo], manager: "PluginsManager", voucher: Optional["Voucher"] = None, voucher_code: Optional["VoucherCode"] = None, database_connection_name: str = settings.DATABASE_CONNECTION_DEFAULT_NAME) -> CheckoutInfo

nodes.name: Checkout editing helpers
nodes.summary: Line edits under row locks, price invalidation, address changes, voucher and gift card codes, deletion and logging helpers.
nodes.detail: add_variants_to_checkout locks the checkout row before its lines to avoid deadlocks, then creates, updates or deletes lines in bulk and reserves stock. invalidate_checkout recalculates discounts and sets price_expiration and discount_expiration to now. Voucher helpers validate codes against the channel, minimum spend and usage limits. is_fully_paid compares legacy payments with the total; cancel_active_payments deactivates legacy payments when a transaction flow starts.

nodes.name: add_variants_to_checkout()
nodes.summary: Creates, updates or deletes checkout lines in one locked database transaction and reserves stock for new and changed lines.
nodes.detail: Locks the checkout row first, then its lines, matches input to locked lines, and bulk-creates, updates or deletes them. When a reservation length is set, it calls reserve_stocks_and_preorders for new and updated lines and only extends reserved_until for untouched ones.
nodes.signature: def add_variants_to_checkout(checkout, variants, checkout_lines_data, channel, replace=False, replace_reservations=False, reservation_length: int | None = None, raise_error_for_missing_lines=False, *, calculate_stocks_with_shipping_zones: bool)

nodes.name: invalidate_checkout_prices()
nodes.summary: Marks prices and discounts as expired by setting both expiration times to now, so the next read recalculates.
nodes.signature: def invalidate_checkout_prices(checkout_info: "CheckoutInfo", *, save: bool) -> list[str]

nodes.name: invalidate_checkout()
nodes.summary: Recalculates voucher and promotion discounts, then expires the cached prices; called by every checkout-editing mutation.
nodes.signature: def invalidate_checkout(checkout_info: "CheckoutInfo", lines: list["CheckoutLineInfo"], manager: "PluginsManager", *, recalculate_discount: bool = True, save: bool) -> list[str]

nodes.name: add_promo_code_to_checkout()
nodes.summary: Applies a code as a voucher if it matches one, otherwise attaches it as a gift card when the channel allows legacy gift card use.
nodes.signature: def add_promo_code_to_checkout(manager: PluginsManager, checkout_info: "CheckoutInfo", lines: list["CheckoutLineInfo"], promo_code: str)

nodes.name: delete_checkouts()
nodes.summary: Deletes checkouts by primary key in one query and returns the count.
nodes.signature: def delete_checkouts(checkout_pks_to_delete: list[UUID]) -> int

nodes.name: Checkout events and payment hooks
nodes.summary: Maps checkout events to plugin manager hooks and reacts when transaction amounts on a checkout change.
nodes.detail: CHECKOUT_WEBHOOK_EVENT_MAP links CHECKOUT_CREATED, UPDATED, FULLY_AUTHORIZED, FULLY_PAID and METADATA_UPDATED to manager methods; the helpers look up subscribed webhooks once and pass them to the manager, which queues asynchronous deliveries. When a transaction changes, the checkout's authorize and charge statuses are recomputed, automatically_refundable is refreshed, and FULLY_PAID or FULLY_AUTHORIZED fires on the transition.

nodes.name: call_checkout_info_event()
nodes.summary: Looks up webhooks for one checkout event and calls the matching plugin manager hook, which delivers it asynchronously.
nodes.signature: def call_checkout_info_event(manager: "PluginsManager", event_name: str, checkout_info: "CheckoutInfo", lines: list["CheckoutLineInfo"], address: Optional["Address"] = None, webhook_event_map: dict[str, set["Webhook"]] | None = None) -> None

nodes.name: transaction_amounts_for_checkout_updated()
nodes.summary: Recalculates checkout prices with a forced status update, then fires payment-status events if the checkout became fully paid or authorized.
nodes.signature: def transaction_amounts_for_checkout_updated(transaction: TransactionItem, checkout: Checkout, manager: "PluginsManager", user: Optional["User"], app: Optional["App"])

nodes.name: _transaction_amounts_for_checkout_updated()
nodes.summary: Updates last_transaction_modified_at and refundability, and sends CHECKOUT_FULLY_PAID or CHECKOUT_FULLY_AUTHORIZED on status transitions.
nodes.signature: def _transaction_amounts_for_checkout_updated(transaction: TransactionItem, previous_charge_status: str, previous_authorize_status: str, checkout_info: CheckoutInfo, lines: list[CheckoutLineInfo], manager: "PluginsManager", user: Optional["User"], app: Optional["App"])

nodes.name: Checkout problems
nodes.summary: Detects line problems (insufficient stock, variant not available) and checkout problems (delivery method stale or invalid).
nodes.detail: get_checkout_lines_problems first flags lines whose product is not published or available in the channel, then compares the remaining lines' quantities with available stock per variant, channel and country. get_checkout_problems adds checkout-level problems: the assigned delivery is stale or no longer valid. The GraphQL problems loaders call these with prefetched stocks and listings.

nodes.name: Checkout row locks
nodes.summary: select_for_update query sets for checkouts and checkout lines, so every caller locks rows the same way.
nodes.detail: checkout_qs_select_for_update and checkout_lines_qs_select_for_update return query sets with select_for_update and a stable ordering. Code that edits lines takes the checkout lock first and the line locks second, which is the documented rule for avoiding deadlocks.

nodes.name: Checkout search indexing
nodes.summary: Builds the PostgreSQL full-text search vector for checkouts from email, customer, addresses, lines, payments and transactions.
nodes.detail: loaders.py fetches the related rows for a batch of checkouts in a few queries and indexing.py turns them into weighted search vector values, then clears search_index_dirty. Mutations only set the dirty flag; the periodic task does the work.

nodes.name: Checkout background jobs
nodes.summary: Celery tasks that delete abandoned checkouts, refresh search vectors and complete fully authorized checkouts automatically.
nodes.detail: The Celery beat schedule in settings runs delete_expired_checkouts daily at midnight, update_checkouts_search_vector_task every 60 seconds and trigger_automatic_checkout_completion_task on its own schedule. Checkouts with live transaction amounts are never deleted.

nodes.name: delete_expired_checkouts()
nodes.summary: Deletes anonymous checkouts idle 30 days, customer checkouts idle 90 days and empty ones idle 6 hours, skipping any with money on transactions.
nodes.detail: Runs in batches of 2,000 rows, 5 batches per run, and re-queues itself up to 500 times while more rows match. The thresholds come from ANONYMOUS_CHECKOUTS_TIMEDELTA, USER_CHECKOUTS_TIMEDELTA and EMPTY_CHECKOUTS_TIMEDELTA.
nodes.signature: def delete_expired_checkouts(batch_size: int = 2000, batch_count: int = 5, invocation_count: int = 1, invocation_limit: int = 500) -> tuple[int, bool]

nodes.name: trigger_automatic_checkout_completion_task()
nodes.summary: Finds fully authorized checkouts with an email or customer and a billing address in channels that opted in, and queues up to 20 completions.
nodes.detail: Per channel it waits automatic_completion_delay minutes after the last change and honours a cut-off date; checkouts not modified within AUTOMATIC_CHECKOUT_COMPLETION_OLDEST_MODIFIED (default 30 days) are skipped. Ordering puts never-attempted checkouts first.
nodes.signature: def trigger_automatic_checkout_completion_task()

nodes.name: automatic_checkout_completion_task()
nodes.summary: Records the attempt time, checks lines and delivery, and calls complete_checkout; validation errors are logged, not raised.
nodes.detail: Declared with retry settings (60 seconds, 5 retries) but no autoretry_for and no self.retry call, so a failed attempt is never retried by Celery; the next scheduler run picks the checkout up again.
nodes.signature: def automatic_checkout_completion_task(self, checkout_pk, user_id=None, app_id=None)

nodes.name: Delivery options cache
nodes.summary: Builds, caches and assigns delivery options for a checkout: built-in shipping methods, app-provided methods and collection points.
nodes.detail: fetch_shipping_methods_for_checkout combines built-in methods valid for the address, weight and channel with methods listed by shipping apps, applies exclusions from filter webhooks, and writes CheckoutDelivery rows inside a transaction that re-checks the assigned delivery did not change. The assigned method is updated in place, or preserved and marked invalid, so a checkout never silently changes its chosen price.

nodes.name: get_or_fetch_checkout_deliveries()
nodes.summary: Returns cached valid CheckoutDelivery rows, or refetches them when delivery_methods_stale_at has passed and synchronous webhooks are allowed.
nodes.signature: def get_or_fetch_checkout_deliveries(checkout_info: "CheckoutInfo", requestor: Union["App", "User", None], allow_sync_webhooks: bool = True) -> Promise[list[CheckoutDelivery]]

nodes.name: fetch_shipping_methods_for_checkout()
nodes.summary: Combines built-in and app shipping methods, applies app exclusions, and rewrites the checkout's CheckoutDelivery rows under a row lock.
nodes.detail: Sets delivery_methods_stale_at to now plus CHECKOUT_DELIVERY_OPTIONS_TTL. If another request changed the assigned delivery meanwhile, it returns an empty list instead of writing.
nodes.signature: def fetch_shipping_methods_for_checkout(checkout_info: "CheckoutInfo", requestor: Union["App", "User", None], overwrite_assigned_delivery: bool = True) -> Promise[list[CheckoutDelivery]]

nodes.name: assign_delivery_method_to_checkout()
nodes.summary: Assigns a CheckoutDelivery or a collection-point warehouse, or clears delivery, then expires prices and sends CHECKOUT_UPDATED.
nodes.signature: def assign_delivery_method_to_checkout(checkout_info: "CheckoutInfo", lines_info: list["CheckoutLineInfo"], manager: "PluginsManager", delivery_method: CheckoutDelivery | Warehouse | None)

nodes.name: Payment models
nodes.summary: TransactionItem and TransactionEvent for the transaction flow, Payment and Transaction for the legacy flow, all in PostgreSQL.
nodes.detail: TransactionItem rows are unique per app identifier and idempotency key and indexed by payment service provider (PSP) reference, app identifier and dates. They keep card and gift card details for display. TransactionEvent rows store type, amount, PSP reference, message, the app or user that reported them and include_in_calculations. Payment keeps billing details, gateway, token, captured amount and charge status; Transaction rows record each gateway call.

nodes.name: TransactionItem model
nodes.summary: One payment attempt handled by an app: amounts authorized, charged, refunded, canceled and pending, linked to a checkout or an order.
facts: TRANSACTION_ITEMS_LIMIT is 100 per checkout or order

nodes.name: TransactionEvent model
nodes.summary: An immutable record of a payment request or result (for example CHARGE_SUCCESS) with amount and PSP reference; amounts are derived from these.

nodes.name: Payment model (legacy)
nodes.summary: Legacy payment on a checkout or order processed by a gateway plugin, with captured amount and charge status.

nodes.name: Transaction model (legacy)
nodes.summary: One legacy gateway call (authorize, capture, refund, void) with its result, amount and raw response.

nodes.name: Payment enums and errors
nodes.summary: PaymentError, TransactionKind, ChargeStatus, TransactionAction and TransactionEventType constants shared by both payment flows.

nodes.name: Payment data classes
nodes.summary: Dataclasses passed to plugins and webhooks: TransactionSessionData, TransactionActionData, PaymentData, GatewayResponse and tokenization types.
nodes.detail: TransactionSessionData carries the transaction, source checkout or order, chosen app, action and amount, customer IP address and idempotency key into session webhooks; TransactionActionData carries a request event and the owning app into charge, refund and cancel requests. PaymentData and GatewayResponse are the legacy plugin contract.

nodes.name: Transaction processing
nodes.summary: Creates transaction items and events from app replies, deduplicates reported events, and propagates amounts to checkouts and orders.
nodes.detail: Replies to session and action webhooks are parsed and validated (result type, amount, PSP reference, available actions). A request event is turned into the result event when the app answers with a request type, otherwise a new event is created. Duplicate events with the same type, PSP reference and amount are reused. Legacy helpers build PaymentData and record Transaction rows.

nodes.summary: Registers payment and transaction queries and the payment, transaction and stored payment method mutations.
nodes.detail: PaymentQueries resolves payment, payments, transaction and transactions behind payment permissions. PaymentMutations registers the transaction and stored payment method mutations and keeps the five legacy payment mutations with a deprecation reason.

nodes.name: Payment GraphQL types
nodes.summary: Payment, Transaction, TransactionItem, TransactionEvent, PaymentGateway, payment method details and stored payment method types.
nodes.detail: TransactionItem exposes amounts, events, available actions and payment method details; createdBy resolves to the app or user. PaymentGateway describes legacy gateways; StoredPaymentMethod lists saved methods returned by apps.

nodes.name: TransactionSessionBase
nodes.summary: Shared base for session mutations: resolves the checkout or order from an id and the amount to pay, defaulting to what is still unpaid.

nodes.name: PaymentGatewayInitialize
nodes.summary: paymentGatewayInitialize: asks one or more payment apps for client configuration (for example a publishable key) before payment.
nodes.detail: Builds PaymentGatewayData per requested app and calls the plugin manager's payment_gateway_initialize_session, which sends the PAYMENT_GATEWAY_INITIALIZE_SESSION synchronous webhook and returns each app's data or error.

nodes.name: TransactionInitialize
nodes.summary: transactionInitialize: starts a payment with a chosen app for a checkout or order, creating the TransactionItem and its first event.
nodes.detail: Rejects locked checkouts, takes an idempotency key (generated if absent), resolves the action from the channel's transaction flow strategy, deactivates legacy payments on the checkout, and calls handle_transaction_initialize_session. A reused key with different details fails with UNIQUE and restores the legacy payments.

nodes.name: TransactionProcess
nodes.summary: transactionProcess: continues a session (for example after 3-D Secure) by sending TRANSACTION_PROCESS_SESSION to the transaction's app.

nodes.name: TransactionEventReport
nodes.summary: transactionEventReport: lets the owning app (or staff with HANDLE_PAYMENTS) report a payment event, deduplicated by type, PSP reference and amount.
nodes.detail: Under a row lock on the transaction it reuses an identical event (alreadyProcessed true), refuses the same PSP reference and type with a different amount, and refuses a second AUTHORIZATION_SUCCESS. A new event recalculates amounts and calls process_order_or_checkout_with_transaction.

nodes.name: TransactionCreate
nodes.summary: transactionCreate: lets an app or staff record a transaction with amounts on a checkout or order directly, outside the session flow.

nodes.name: TransactionUpdate
nodes.summary: transactionUpdate: changes amounts, metadata or details of an existing transaction and propagates the new amounts.

nodes.name: TransactionRequestAction
nodes.summary: transactionRequestAction: staff ask the owning app to charge, refund or cancel; gift card transactions are handled in-process.

nodes.name: TransactionRequestRefundForGrantedRefund
nodes.summary: Requests a refund for an order's granted refund on a chosen transaction and tracks the granted refund's status.

nodes.name: Transaction mutation helpers
nodes.summary: Finds a transaction by id or token, cleans the customer IP address and creates request events for actions.
nodes.detail: get_transaction_item accepts a token or a GraphQL id; numeric ids select transactions created before Saleor 3.13 with use_old_id set. create_transaction_event_requested writes the request event with the requesting app or user before an action is sent.

nodes.name: Stored payment method mutations
nodes.summary: Tokenization and deletion of saved payment methods through payment apps' synchronous webhooks.
nodes.detail: PaymentGatewayInitializeTokenization, PaymentMethodInitializeTokenization, PaymentMethodProcessTokenization and StoredPaymentMethodRequestDelete each call a plugin manager hook that sends the matching synchronous webhook to the app and maps its result enum to the response.

nodes.name: Payment gateway facade
nodes.summary: Wraps gateway plugin calls (process, authorize, capture, refund, void, confirm) and routes transaction action requests to apps or plugins.

nodes.name: Tax models
nodes.summary: TaxConfiguration per channel, TaxConfigurationPerCountry exceptions, TaxClass and TaxClassCountryRate flat rates.
nodes.detail: TaxConfiguration is one-to-one with a channel and defaults to charging taxes, FLAT_RATES, gross display and prices entered with tax. A country exception overrides charge_taxes, strategy, display, tax_app_id and weighted shipping tax for one country. Rates are percentages per class and country; a rate row with no class is the country default.

nodes.name: TaxConfiguration model
nodes.summary: A channel's tax settings: charge_taxes, tax_calculation_strategy, display_gross_prices, prices_entered_with_tax, tax_app_id, weighted shipping.

nodes.name: TaxConfigurationPerCountry model
nodes.summary: A per-country override of a channel's tax configuration, unique per configuration and country.

nodes.name: TaxClassCountryRate model
nodes.summary: A flat tax rate for a tax class in a country, or the country default when the class is empty.

nodes.name: Tax configuration resolution
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective tax settings for a checkout or order by applying the country exception for its active country.
nodes.detail: The active country is the shipping address country, else the billing address country, else the channel default. Each getter returns the country exception's value when one exists for that country, else the channel's. A missing strategy falls back to FLAT_RATES; a missing country tax_app_id falls back to the channel's. It also computes shipping tax rates, weighted by line totals when configured.

nodes.name: get_tax_calculation_strategy()
nodes.summary: Returns the country exception's strategy if an exception exists, else the channel's, defaulting to FLAT_RATES.
nodes.detail: An exception row with an empty strategy yields FLAT_RATES rather than the channel's strategy.
nodes.signature: def get_tax_calculation_strategy(channel_tax_configuration: "TaxConfiguration", country_tax_configuration: Optional["TaxConfigurationPerCountry"]) -> str

nodes.name: Flat rate tax math
nodes.summary: Converts an amount and a percentage into net and gross amounts, depending on whether prices include tax.
nodes.detail: calculate_flat_rate_tax works on Money and a percentage; get_taxed_undiscounted_price reuses the already taxed price when the undiscounted base equals it, which avoids rounding differences between app and local calculations.

nodes.name: calculate_flat_rate_tax()
nodes.summary: Divides gross by one plus the rate when prices include tax, else multiplies net by it.
nodes.signature: def calculate_flat_rate_tax(money: "Money", tax_rate: "Decimal", prices_entered_with_tax: bool ) -> TaxedMoney

nodes.name: Checkout flat rate taxes
nodes.summary: Applies flat rates to each checkout line by its tax class and country, then to shipping, and sums subtotal and total.
nodes.detail: The country default rate is the TaxClassCountryRate with no tax class. Line totals are taxed after discounts; shipping uses its own tax class rate or a rate weighted by line totals when use_weighted_tax_for_shipping is on.

nodes.name: update_checkout_prices_with_flat_rates()
nodes.summary: Looks up the country default and each line's class rate, taxes line totals and shipping, and sets checkout subtotal and total.
nodes.signature: def update_checkout_prices_with_flat_rates(checkout: "Checkout", checkout_info: "CheckoutInfo", lines: list["CheckoutLineInfo"], prices_entered_with_tax: bool, database_connection_name: str = settings.DATABASE_CONNECTION_DEFAULT_NAME)

nodes.name: Order flat rate taxes
nodes.summary: The same flat rate calculation for orders, used when an order's prices are refreshed.
nodes.detail: update_order_prices_with_flat_rates loads rates for the order lines' tax classes in one query, taxes each line and shipping, and sets order subtotal, undiscounted totals and total. The orders area calls it when an order's prices must be refreshed.

nodes.name: Tax webhook dispatch
nodes.summary: Sends a CALCULATE_TAXES synchronous webhook to the configured tax app or to all subscribed apps, and parses replies into TaxData.
nodes.detail: With an app identifier, the newest active app with that identifier and its webhook for the event are used; a missing app or webhook rejects with TaxDataError. Without one, every subscribed webhook is called and the first reply that parses wins, with a warning that this fallback will stop working in future releases.

nodes.name: get_taxes_for_app_identifier()
nodes.summary: Finds the tax app and its webhook, fires the synchronous webhook and validates the reply against the expected line count.

nodes.name: Tax reply parser
nodes.summary: Validates tax app replies into TaxData and turns validation failures into TaxDataError messages short enough for checkout.tax_error.
nodes.detail: The pydantic CalculateTaxesSchema checks that the reply has one entry per line, non-negative amounts and rates; errors are logged with the event type and truncated to TAX_ERROR_FIELD_LENGTH before being stored on the checkout or order.

flows.name: A shopper pays through a payment app
flows.summary: From an empty cart to a fully authorized checkout using the transaction application programming interface (API) and a payment app such as Stripe.

steps.text: The storefront calls the GraphQL endpoint on the shopper's behalf.
checkoutCreate makes the checkout in a channel, adds lines and reserves stock. Prices start expired.
After addresses are set, checkoutDeliveryMethodUpdate assigns one of the cached delivery options and expires the prices again.
Reading totalPrice recalculates discounts and taxes because price_expiration has passed, then caches the result for an hour.
paymentGatewayInitialize asks the payment app, over a synchronous webhook, for the data its client-side widget needs.
transactionInitialize checks the checkout is not being completed, picks charge or authorize from the channel, and deactivates any legacy payments.
A TransactionItem and a request event are created or reused by idempotency key.
The webhook plugin sends TRANSACTION_INITIALIZE_SESSION to the app and waits for its answer.
The payment app, here the Stripe app, answers with a result type, amount, PSP (payment service provider) reference and optional data for the storefront's payment widget.
The reply becomes a TransactionEvent; amounts are recalculated from the events.
When the provider confirms asynchronously, the app reports the final event with transactionEventReport, deduplicated by type, reference and amount.
With the checkout and transaction locked, the checkout's statuses are recomputed.
authorize_status becomes FULL once authorized plus charged amounts cover the total net of gift cards.
The transition fires CHECKOUT_FULLY_AUTHORIZED or CHECKOUT_FULLY_PAID; the storefront can now call checkoutComplete, or automatic completion picks it up.

flows.name: Checkout completion turns a cart into an order
flows.summary: How checkoutComplete validates, locks and converts a paid checkout into an order with allocated stock and moved payments.

steps.text: checkoutComplete loads the checkout; if it is gone but an order carries its token, that order is returned so retries are safe.
Stale delivery options are refreshed and the delivery method and both addresses are validated.
Prices are refreshed (forced if a tax error is recorded); a remaining tax error stops completion. A fully authorized checkout takes the transaction path.
Authorizations must cover the total unless the channel allows unpaid orders; vouchers and gift cards are re-checked and tax plugins may veto.
Voucher usage is increased, then the checkout row is locked and its lines and info re-read inside the transaction.
The Order row is created with totals net of gift cards, status UNFULFILLED or UNCONFIRMED, lines and discounts.
Stock is allocated across warehouses, consuming the checkout's own reservations; insufficient stock rolls everything back and releases the voucher.
Transactions and legacy payments are moved to the order and its charge and authorize data recomputed.
order_created and the confirmation email are scheduled for after commit.
On commit the orders area runs order_created, which also charges gift card transactions and sends ORDER_CREATED webhooks.
The checkout is deleted, so its token now resolves only to the order.

flows.name: Prices and taxes are recalculated after a cart change
flows.summary: How a line change expires cached prices and the next price read recalculates them with flat rates or a tax app.

steps.text: checkoutLinesAdd writes the lines and calls invalidate_checkout.
price_expiration and discount_expiration are set to now; nothing is recalculated yet.
When the response asks for totalPrice, the price dataloader runs fetch_checkout_data.
Prices are expired, so discounts are recalculated and the channel's tax settings for the active country are resolved.
FLAT_RATES uses tax class rates; TAX_APP calls the configured app or plugin.
Flat rates: each line and shipping is taxed with the class rate for the country, or the country default.
Tax app: the checkout is serialized with base prices into a CHECKOUT_CALCULATE_TAXES payload.
The newest active app with the configured identifier receives the synchronous webhook.
The AvaTax app answers with per-line net and gross totals and shipping tax.
The reply is validated line by line; an invalid reply becomes tax_error and untaxed base prices.
The new prices and an expiry one CHECKOUT_PRICES_TTL ahead are saved, unless last_change moved meanwhile.
